find: const blob: SaveBlob = { format: SAVE_FORMAT, version: SAVE_VERSION, namespace, keys };
replace: const blob: SaveBlob = { format: SAVE_FORMAT, version: SAVE_VERSION, keys };
why: Exports a blob that does not say which namespace it came from (issue #250). The blob's KEYS are the store-facing names in either namespace, so two exports of different namespaces are otherwise byte-identical and nothing downstream can tell them apart. Every later guard depends on this field existing, so dropping it defeats the whole feature while leaving the export apparently working. Measured, not estimated: 7 of 37 in save.test.ts.
